title: ROADMAP DEBT PAYMENT WELCOME PASS
description: The patch turns a design concern into a calendar decision and calls that production maturity. Three long-promised fixes ship with direct patch notes, no event wrapper, and no commemorative bundle. Early sessions now surface clearer genre hooks for players who have not memorized the wiki by birth.
consequence: Players reacted with suspicion to a promise being kept in daylight. The game waved at strangers without asking them to craft a spreadsheet first.

title: ROADMAP DEBT PAYMENT EXPERT MODE
description: The feature asks players to perform progress for each other before asking whether the progress is good. Three long-promised fixes ship with direct patch notes, no event wrapper, and no commemorative bundle. New systems lean into late-game complexity for players already fluent in the existing disaster.
consequence: Players reacted with suspicion to a promise being kept in daylight. The audience got smaller, sharper, and much harder to onboard at parties.

title: ASPIRATIONAL ROADMAP REFRESH WELCOME PASS
description: The release frames the feature as seasonal structure, while burying the real priority in the reward cadence. Previously announced features have been reframed as directional pillars while the team evaluates delivery confidence. Early sessions now surface clearer genre hooks for players who have not memorized the wiki by birth.
consequence: The roadmap survived by becoming less related to roads. The game waved at strangers without asking them to craft a spreadsheet first.
